# `indent_style`

Indent with spaces or tabs.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `space` |  |
| `tab` |  |

**Default:** `space`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```

### `indent_style = space`

```editorconfig
indent_style = space
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `indent_style = tab`

```editorconfig
indent_style = tab
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
	public int Value { get; set; }

	public int Double()
	{
		return Value * 2;
	}
}
```
